Audit 2048: exact seven-fix non-UI behavior map
Original merge: e8c955d91

This maps the seven fixes selected by the authoritative audit, not the whole
WASM feature ancestry. It is not an audit completion ledger.

4a34815ea: auth picker callback persistence/failure
  Source: go/internal/cli/commands/auth_picker_callbacks_test.go
  Test: TestAuthPickerCallbacksPersistOrReportFailure
  Production callbacks persist/reread private config, preserve sessions, reject
  stale selections and preserve corrupt config bytes. No terminal rendering.
  Parent addition d51a373e3: normal 0.078s; silent-clear control fails the
  concealed-config-failure assertion. Evidence retained by parent:
  /tmp/wendy-audit2048-control-20261113/control.log

1bc631e78: bounded repair of malformed API review provider output
  Source: .github/scripts/api_review_test.py
  Tests: test_invalid_json_gets_one_complete_response_repair,
  test_repair_remains_strict_and_is_bounded_to_one_attempt,
  test_truncated_response_does_not_enter_schema_repair.
  Additional cases verify same-batch evidence, retained decisions/risk,
  redaction and fail-closed incomplete results. Actual automation parser and
  repair code consumes controlled provider responses; no live model-service
  execution or review-quality claim.
  Offline automation job 131700219478, run 43368990597, passed; parent retained
  the complete 578-test result.

6acc2f31b: review batching, MCU tenant derivation, dependency/test compatibility
  Sources: .github/scripts/api_review_test.py and
  go/internal/agent/mcusource/mtls_identity_transport_test.go.
  Tests: test_large_diff_reviews_every_file_and_combines_highest_risk,
  test_one_failed_batch_cannot_publish_partial_decisions,
  TestSensorAssetIdentityOverTLSAndGRPC.
  Existing automation cases also reject out-of-batch evidence and cover
  oversized files. Twelve new TCP/TLS and gRPC cases authenticate the consumer,
  exchange exact application bytes/manifest and reject wrong tenant/asset before
  dispatch. Legacy and SPIFFE leaves work despite stale pairing OrgID.
  Reintroducing pairing-derived scope fails both correct-peer transport
  boundaries under the race detector. No public PKI or MCU hardware is used.
  Swift reconciliation: both original Swift files changed only tests: help
  wording, Foundation import, a public certificate fixture for missing-device
  preflight, and an enabled missing-auth-before-device case. They did not
  implement Swift enrollment. Help/render cases are outside this non-UI task;
  those Swift E2E cases are not claimed as newly executed.
  New MCU gate passes locally; required hosted integration remains pending.

10b0dc858: native cross-process OAuth refresh/checkpoint serialization
  Source: go/internal/cli/commands/auth_refresh_lock_test.go
  Tests: TestOAuthRefreshAcrossProcesses,
  TestOAuthRefreshConcurrentCloudContexts, TestOAuthRefreshLockCancellation,
  TestOAuthRefreshRejectsRemovedSession, TestOAuthRefreshPersistsOnlySelectedSession,
  TestOAuthCheckpointSerializesWithConfigUpdateAcrossProcesses.
  Real child processes, filesystem locks/config and controlled HTTP refresh
  peers exercise rotation and checkpointing. This native process proof is
  distinct from browser-worker storage. Parent selected suite passed 11.942s:
  /tmp/wendy-audit2048-native-20261113.log

91c7342c3: Cloud v2 discovery identity and trusted certificate destinations
  Sources: go/internal/cli/commands/cloud_discover_v2_test.go and
  go/internal/agent/acmeenroll/acmeenroll_test.go.
  Tests: TestCloudDiscoverJSONV2, TestCloudDiscoveryJSONPreservesPKIDeviceBinding,
  TestCloudDiscoveryV2DoesNotUseRetiredRelay, TestCloudPickerUsesV2AndPreservesUUID,
  TestPKICertificateGETRestrictsDestination, TestEnrollDownloadsPKIGetOnlyCertificate.
  Local gRPC peers exercise roster/request handling and identity selection;
  actual local HTTP ACME tests count trusted and rejected destination requests.
  No picker rendering or live Cloud service compatibility is inferred.
  Parent native selected suite and full protocol suite passed:
  /tmp/wendy-audit2048-protocols-20261113.log

fd5a8ef90: request clientAuth and serverAuth in the signed ACME CSR
  Source: go/internal/agent/acmeenroll/acmeenroll_test.go
  Tests: TestEnroll, TestEnrollRejectsUnusableAuthenticationUsages.
  Local ACME server parses the actual finalized CSR, verifies its signature,
  decodes the EKU ASN.1 extension and requires both usage OIDs. Invalid issued
  usages are rejected. Full package passed 0.197s in the parent protocol run.
  No production certificate is minted.

bc8bcbf4f: test-only principal-aware pin API compatibility
  Source: go/internal/cli/commands/vm_identity_test.go
  Tests: TestVMIdentityUsesNameNotLoopbackOrPort,
  TestVMReconnectPreservesAliasAndFullEndpoint.
  Original change adds the empty principal argument to five test calls. No
  production behavior or VM boot is inferred from this compatibility fix.
  Alias-selection test passed in the parent's selected native run; reconnect
  is existing coverage, not separately claimed from that selected run.

Original browser action: independent storage/refresh and auth-proxy coverage
  Sources: web-client/tests/credential-store.test.mjs,
  web-client/tests/auth-proxy.test.mjs, web-client/tests/wendy-web-bridge.test.mjs,
  go/cmd/wendy-web/credentials_js_test.go,
  go/internal/cli/browserauth/storage_test.go.
  Existing Browser WASM job runs actual built Go WASM/worker code, WebCrypto
  wrapping and IndexedDB adapters, restored sessions/token rotation, and
  single-use transactions across worker contexts. Auth proxy tests execute the
  real route with controlled fetch, exact method/destination permissions,
  manual redirects and zero forwarding to untrusted URLs. Native browserauth
  separately proves certificate/key continuity and fail-closed rotated restore.
  Hosted Browser WASM success:
  https://github.com/wendylabsinc/WendyOS/actions/runs/43368990597/job/131700219405
  Parent retains exact source comparison/logs. Native browserauth passed 2.065s.
  Limits: fake-indexeddb and Go's JS adapter are not a real browser profile,
  actual browser Web Locks or public auth/PKI. Opt-in TestLiveCloudRelay was not
  run. No UI, real-user sign-in or external credentials are claimed.

New gate and registration
  python3 .github/scripts/test-sensor-asset-identity.py NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
  Existing Linux Go race row; no new job/matrix. Existing Go/race compiler and
  Python; inherits GOFLAGS. Each normal/control compile-and-test is guarded at
  180 seconds and Go runtime is bounded to 45 seconds. Twelve normal subtests
  and both named old-assumption failures are required; no skips accepted.
  Output: source hashes, normal.log, pairing-org.log, evidence.json.
  Local normal and control are race-instrumented; see
  /tmp/wendy-audit2048-mcu-proof-20261113/evidence.json.

Closure rule
  Reconcile these exact assertions and hosted source heads with the audit
  before changing status. New MCU gate awaits required hosted execution.
  This map alone does not close the mixed audit or its external acceptance.
